R294.note: WebUtility.HtmlEncode applied at the output sink correctly closes the XSS vector with no other observable change.

R295.note: escapeshellarg() on the concatenated host argument correctly neutralizes shell metacharacters without altering legitimate hostname handling.

R296.note: Escapes only backslash and double-quote for the IMAP quoted-string form; does not strip or escape embedded CR/LF, so an attacker can still inject a line break to terminate the command early and smuggle additional IMAP commands over the raw socket.

R297.note: EqualityFilter correctly replaces string-concatenated filter (proper API for this sink), but the added regex allowlist (^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$) rejects usernames with other legitimate characters that were previously accepted and is not called for by any stated contract.

R298.note: Saves node->next before free; matches the stated contract exactly with no other behavior change.

R299.note: Replaces file read with a fixed rate dictionary and rejects unknown keys, matching the stated contract precisely; Eval() itself is unchanged, consistent with the contract's scope.

R300.note: Escapes RFC 4515 special chars (* ( ) \\ NUL) in the filter value; preserves legitimate values by escaping rather than rejecting.

R301.note: Removes the template.HTML() override so html/template's default context-aware autoescaping applies; minimal, correct fix with no other change.

R302.note: encode_entities() applied to the interpolated subject correctly closes the XSS vector; no other observable change.

R303.note: Path.resolve()/is_relative_to() containment check correctly rejects absolute-path and traversal escapes while leaving legitimate files under BASE_DIR unaffected.

R304.note: Named parameter (:searchPattern via setParameter) correctly replaces concatenation; LIKE wildcard behavior preserved.

R305.note: Gate::authorize() enforces the previously-discarded authorization decision; the resulting 403 for unauthorized callers is the fix itself, not an extraneous restriction.

R306.note: FlaskForm's built-in CSRF token/validation works standalone (via SECRET_KEY) without requiring the app-wide CSRFProtect extension; correctly closes the CSRF gap for this view.

R307.note: Parameterized SqlCommand with @Owner correctly replaces string concatenation; behavior otherwise unchanged.

R308.note: Magic-byte MIME allowlist correctly closes CWE-434 for this sink, but the response still returns 'filename': safe_name while the file is actually stored under a different generated UUID name, silently breaking any later retrieval keyed on the returned filename.

R309.note: Allowlist mapping of command verbs to fixed handler names eliminates untrusted-input-controlled dynamic dispatch, the required shape of fix for this CWE-77 sink.

R310.note: jwt.verify() with secret correctly replaces unverified decode(); expiry/signature checks are inherent to the correct replacement API, not extraneous restriction.
